params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Vault Breaker's'' {{sti|range}}, speed, and damage over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
params.description2: ''Vault Breaker'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Vault Breaker'' is cancelled, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded, and it is placed on {{sti|cd|full cooldown}}. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded and it is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second cooldown}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within her path, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 150 for 11|0 to 1.25|round1=3|formula=15% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and {{tip|airborne|pull}} all non-champions hit towards her.

params.description5: ''{{ai|Relentless Force|Vi}} and {{ai|Cease and Desist|Vi}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.notes:
* ''Vault Breaker's'' dash range extends up to 50 units when going through a wall.
* Targets will be hit as soon as they come into contact with '''Vi'''.
* The knockback direction will be toward '''Vi's''' facing direction regardless of where she hit the target.
* Casting {{si|Flash}} during the dash will cause enemies at the destination to be hit by ''Vault Breaker''.
** As {{si|Flash}} updates '''Vi's''' facing direction, affected champions will be knocked back in the direction the summoner spell was cast in.
* '''Vi''' may cast spells that change her facing direction during the dash, including certain item actives and her own {{ai|R|Vi}}, to knock champions she collides with in a different direction.{{bug|2}}
** Items that also initiate their own {{tip|dash}} ''immediately'' without delay can only redirect targets struck at ''Vault Breaker's'' maximum range. These items include:
*** {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}}
* Stuck targets (including those that block ''Vault Breaker'' with a {{tip|spell shield}}) are briefly immune to being affected again by ''Vault Breaker'' from this player, for about {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

blurb.plain: Active: Vi charges up to a few seconds to increase the range, speed, and damage of her punch. Vault Breaker can be recast within the duration and cancels automatically afterwards.

blurb2.plain: Recast: Vi dashes in the target direction to deal physical damage to enemies hit based on charge time. Non-champions hit are pulled towards her.

blurb3.plain: She will stop upon hitting an enemy champion, briefly knocking them back.

description.plain: Active: Vi charges while being slowed by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase Vault Breaker's range, speed, and damage over the first 1.25 seconds of the channel.

description2.plain: Vault Breaker can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, Vault Breaker is cancelled, 50% of the mana cost is refunded, and it is placed on full cooldown. If the charge is interrupted, 50% of the mana cost is refunded and it is placed on a 3-second cooldown.

description3.plain: Recast: Vi dashes in the target direction to deal physical damage to enemies within her path, increased by 0% – 150% (based on channel time), and pull all non-champions hit towards her.

description4.plain: She stops upon hitting an enemy champion, knocking them back over 0.75 seconds.

description5.plain: Relentless Force and Cease and Desist can be cast during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Vi}} {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows''.
params.blurb2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} and inflict {{sti|armor|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for a few seconds. '''Vi''' will also gain {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vi's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
params.description2: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.
params.notes:
* The armor penetration will apply after the triggering damage.
* The enhanced attack applies other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can both {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal as well as apply {{sti|life steal|link=true}} (the bonus damage cannot do either).
* ''Denting Blows'' can be {{tip|blocked}} but cannot be {{tip|dodged}} nor missed while '''Vi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* The attacks do not affect {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Vi}} next basic attack gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit in a cone.
params.blurb2: '''Vi''' periodically stocks a charge of ''Relentless Force'', up to a maximum of 2.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit in a cone.

''Relentless Force'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Vi|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.
params.description2: '''Vi''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Relentless Force'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description3: ''Relentless Force {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vi's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target, applies {{tip|basic damage}} required effects on the primary target, and applies {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.
* The empowered attack has the same windup time as '''Vi's''' basic attacks.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block damage to secondary targets, but not to the primary target.
* ''Relentless Force'' will only apply a stack of {{ai|Denting Blows|Vi}} to the primary target.
* If the ''Relentless Force'' buff is about to run out as '''Vi''' starts the attack windup, the duration will be updated and extended to allow '''Vi''' to still sucessfully attack.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vi}} {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target enemy champion and {{tip|dashes}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them.
params.blurb2: Upon reaching the target, she deals {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' singles out the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards them and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them. Upon approaching within 300 units of the target, she {{tip|dashes}} through and grabs them over {{tt|{{fd|1.05}} seconds|Estimated}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|1.3}} seconds and dealing {{as|physical damage}} after {{fd|0.75}} seconds into the grab duration.
params.description2: Enemies she dashes through are dealt the same damage, {{tip|airborne|knocked aside}} by 350 units over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.speed: {{tt|800|Initial speed, ramps up over the duration}}
params.notes:
* '''Vi''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will stop dashing if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|1500|Estimated}} units.
* '''Vi''' will land to the opposite side of the target from the dash after the grab ends.
** She will not dash through the target if she would not be able to land to the opposite side of them, such as by terrain.
* Secondary targets will be affected as soon as they come into contact with '''Vi''', and cannot be affected by this again for ~4 seconds.
* The {{tip|airborne}} debuff cannot be overridden.
* The dash will not be overridden if '''Vi''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} during it.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of grabbing the target, or at the end of the dash if ''Cease and Desist'' is canceled, whichever comes first.
* '''Vi's''' {{tip|displacement immunity}} and the target's {{tip|true sight|reveal}} both last until the grab ends.
** If the dash ends from entering resurrection or the target being too far away, the displacement immunity will remain for 7 seconds, and will otherwise be lost.{{bug}}
* The dash speed increases with time travelled.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}** This will also occur for when '''Vi''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time.
* If the target becomes untargetable during the dash, '''Vi''' ends the dash prematurely and moves towards the target briefly, ignoring any movement commands. If '''Vi''' enters grabbing range, she will apply the {{tip|airborne}} effect but not deal any damage.
* ''Cease and Desist'' will cancel and go on full cooldown if '''Vi''' is affected by {{ai|Fear Beyond Death 2|Urgot|Fear Beyond Death's}} recast during the cast time.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Vi''' is {{tip|dash|dashing}} and has grabbed the target:
** {{si|Flash}} cannot be used during the grab.
** This lockout is removed as soon as the grab ends, after which the the target's remaining {{tip|airborne}} time will be {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
